additionalProperties.description: Text for this locale, up to 256 characters.

l10n.description: Key in the localization scope, 1–128 characters.

description.description: Optional human-readable description, up to 512 characters.

kind.description: Offer kind: paid purchases a product; free grants a reward without payment; ad grants a reward for rewarded advertising.

format.description: Rewarded advertising format: rewarded or rewarded_interstitial; used for ad offers.

limits.description: Maximum offer uses per player in the specified windows; free offers are checked when ordering, paid and ad offers are limited by the client.

perSession.description: Maximum uses per player in one game session; enforced by the client.

perHour.description: Maximum uses per player in an hour (3600 seconds).

perDay.description: Maximum uses per player in a UTC day.

total.description: Maximum uses per player across all time.

cooldownSec.description: Minimum interval between offer uses, in seconds; checked when ordering free offers and by the client for paid/ad offers.

durationSec.description: Client-side offer availability duration, in seconds; null means no duration is specified.

schedule.description: Client-side availability schedule: a UTC cron expression or an ISO date/time or window in the scheduling format; null means no schedule is specified.

ui.description: Optional offer presentation settings; variant settings override offer settings.

variants.description: Offer variants; each has a unique key, and a default variant must be present. Paid variants reference a product; free/ad variants contain reward entities.

items.description: Offer variants; each has a unique key, and a default variant must be present. Paid variants reference a product; free/ad variants contain reward entities.

key.description: Variant key, 1–64 characters; default identifies the fallback variant.

description.description: Optional human-readable variant description, up to 512 characters.

productKey.description: Record key in iap.settings.products identifying the product purchased by a paid offer.

ui.description: Optional presentation overrides for this variant.

entities.description: Inventory reward granted by a free/ad variant; paid rewards are defined in the product.

items.description: Inventory reward granted by a free/ad variant; paid rewards are defined in the product.

amount.description: Number of units to grant, an integer from 1 to 1000000.

custom.description: Optional game-defined JSON data for this variant.

customs.description: Optional game-defined JSON data for this offer.

purchaseLimit.description: Server-enforced per-player offer purchase limit for every offer kind. Omitted: unlimited. Pending orders reserve capacity; cancellation or ad expiry returns it; paid expiry retains it for late settlement. Fixed epoch-aligned windows; period omitted means lifetime.

period.description: day, week, or a positive ISO-8601 fixed duration (days/hours/minutes/seconds); runtime bounds 1 second to 366 days. No months or years.

requiredEntitlement.description: Purchased non-consumable/subscription product key required by the server before a single-claim free reward. Requires kind=free and limits.total=1.
